terms.definition: The charge stored per unit potential difference, C = Q/V.
terms.examiner: The farad is one coulomb per volt.

terms.definition: The ratio of the permittivity of a material to the permittivity of free space, ε_r = ε/ε₀.
terms.examiner: Also called the dielectric constant. C = Aε₀ε_r/d.

terms.definition: The product RC: the time for the charge on a discharging capacitor to fall to 1/e (about 37%) of its initial value.
